items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMwNzc1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--efff7467f755cf862a58e338598496d0aad69b9b/D8BA8322-C907-471D-B56C-53219F744BBB.png) **German** Liebe Cuberinnen und Cuber, wir freuen uns, euch zum Wuppertaler Würfel-Wochenende am 20. und 21. März 2027 einzuladen! Nach drei erfolgreichen Wettbewerben im Herbst 2025, Frühjahr 2026 und Herbst 2026 geht unser Würfel-Wochenende in die nächste Runde. Auch diesmal heißen wir euch herzlich in Wuppertal willkommen, um gemeinsam ein spannendes Wochenende rund um den Zauberwürfel zu erleben. Ganz gleich, ob ihr zum ersten Mal an einem offiziellen WCA-Wettbewerb teilnehmt oder bereits erfahrene Cuberinnen und Cuber seid – bei uns sind alle herzlich willkommen! Freut euch auf spannende Solves, neue persönliche Bestzeiten, jede Menge Spaß und natürlich viele Begegnungen mit der Cubing-Community. Bitte lest euch vor der Anmeldung alle Informationen auf der Wettbewerbsseite sorgfältig durch. Wir freuen uns auf euch und ein tolles Würfel-Wochenende in Wuppertal! **English** Dear cubers, We are excited to invite you to the Wuppertal Cubing Weekend on March 20–21, 2027! Following three successful competitions in autumn 2025, spring 2026, and autumn 2026, we are delighted to welcome you back to Wuppertal for another exciting weekend of speedcubing. Whether you’re joining your very first official WCA competition or you’re already an experienced competitor, everyone is warmly welcome! Look forward to exciting solves, new personal bests, lots of fun, and, of course, meeting fellow cubers from the community. Please make sure to read all information on the competition page carefully before registering. We can’t wait to see you in Wuppertal for another fantastic cubing weekend!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMyMzU4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--145408a7a4c01909fa0bed8fda14d9b6e0d538f9/ChapiOpenV5.jpg) ¡Bienvenidos al Chapinería Open 2027! El sábado 13 de febrero de 2027 llevamos el speedcubing a la Sierra Oeste de Madrid, con 8 categorías y 64 competidores. **Adiós Clock**: El Clock deja de ser oficial después del Mundial de julio de 2027. ¡Aprovecha una de las últimas oportunidades! **Hola FTO**: El FTO será oficial en la WCA desde el 2 de enero de 2027, así que esta será una de las primeras competiciones de Madrid en las que se pueda conseguir un resultado oficial. **Cronómetros en modo 4-pad**: Desde el 2 de enero de 2027, los intentos oficiales se hacen con el Speed Stacks G5 StackMat Pro en modo 4-pad. Si nunca lo has probado, tendremos una mesa de práctica abierta antes de empezar. No se puede comer ni beber en esa mesa. ------------------ Welcome to the Chapinería Open 2027! On Saturday, February 13, 2027, we are bringing speedcubing to Madrid’s Sierra Oeste, featuring 8 categories and 64 competitors. **Goodbye Clock** Clock will no longer be an official event after the July 2027 World Championship. Make the most of one of your last chances to compete in it! **Hello FTO** FTO will officially join the WCA on January 2, 2027, making this one of the very first competitions in Madrid where you can register an official result. **Timers in 4-Pad Mode**: Starting January 2, 2027, official attempts must be made using the Speed Stacks G5 StackMat Pro in 4-pad mode. If you have never tried it, we will have an open practice table available before the competition starts. Eating and drinking are strictly prohibited at the practice table.

items.information: # Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Vålerenga Vinter B Søndag 24. januar 2027. Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMxMTg0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--51ef0c33761172a278f87103ec71027e21507a07/BCN%20Logo%20goldig%20sparkle%20Farbfl%C3%A4che%20f%C3%BCr%20Fact%20Sheet400.png) [*DE*] ❗ Dieser Wettkampf wird in zwei Gruppen durchgeführt. Du wirst in einer Gruppe antreten und in der anderen Gruppe entweder als Runner, Judge oder Scrambler mithelfen. Du **MUSST** während der gesamten Dauer beider Gruppen anwesend sein (d.h. von 18:00 bis 20:20 Uhr), sonst darfst du nicht teilnehmen. #### Spezielles Format **Dieses Turnier wird in einem speziellen und temporeichen Format ausgetragen. Es eignet sich besonders für Teilnehmende mit Turniererfahrung. Für jüngere Teilnehmende ohne Turniererfahrung könnte das Format eine Herausforderung darstellen. Wer sich die Teilnahme dennoch zutraut, ist selbstverständlich herzlich willkommen! Alle Teilnehmenden, die zum ersten Mal an einem Turnier dabei sind, bitten wir, bereits um 17.30 Uhr vor Ort zu sein. Ausserdem empfehlen wir dringend, das [Judging-Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) vor dem Turnier anzusehen.** ✅ Bitte lies vor deiner Anmeldung unbedingt den Reiter „[Rush-Hour Format](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BernFTONight2027#83039-rush-hour-format)“ durch. 🍕 Nach der Comp essen wir zusammen Pizza. Mehr Infos im Reiter "[Pizza](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BernFTONight2027#83043-pizza)". --- [*FR*] ❗Cette compétition se déroulera en deux groupes. Tu participeras à l'un des groupes et tu aideras l'autre groupe en tant que runner, juge ou scrambler. Tu **DOIS** être présent pendant toute la durée des deux groupes (c'est-à-dire de 18 h 00 à 20 h 20), sinon tu ne pourras pas participer. #### Format particulier **Ce tournoi suit un format particulier et rapide, qui convient davantage aux personnes ayant déjà une certaine expérience des tournois. items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMzNDQ3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--070afc5c6ebb00facc7332fc5e99446dba39c7e7/KCCU-logowidth.png)](https://www.kccu.kr/) ## 본 대회는 3x3x3 큐브 종목을 진행하지 않습니다. ## 4-패드 방식 도입 WCA는 2027년 1월 2일부터 모든 공식 기록 측정 시도에 대해 기존의 2-패드 모드 대신 스피드 스택스 G5 StackMat™ Pro Timer의 4-패드 모드를 사용해야 한다고 발표했습니다. 이번 대회는 대한민국에서 최초로 4-패드 방식을 도입하는 대회가 될 예정입니다. WCA의 공식 발표는 [이곳](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/adoption-of-4-pad-timing-august-2026)에서 확인하실 수 있습니다. WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaTemplate2099#66188-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaTemplate2099#66187-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인해 주십시오. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2) 및 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 경우 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원활한 기록 측정 및 대회 진행을 위해 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청해 주십시오. 원활한 스태프 업무 수행을 위해 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청해 주십시오. --- ## There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition. ## Implementation of 4-Pad The World Cube Association has announced that as of January 2nd, 2027, all timed attempts must use a Speed Stacks G5 StackMat™ Pro Timer in 4-pad mode, as opposed to the previous 2-pad mode. This competition will be the first in Republic of Korea to do so. You can read the WCA's announcement [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/adoption-of-4-pad-timing-august-2026). If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaTemplate2099#66188-for-new-competitors) and [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaTemplate2099#66187-frequently-asked-questions) tabs before registering. All competitors are strongly encouraged to familiarize themselves with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). In accordance with WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to perform staff duties when requested by the organization team. Please watch the [competitor tutorial video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to familiarize yourself with the competition procedures. Please watch the [staff tutorial video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to familiarize yourself with staff duties.

items.information: Welcome to the first competition of 2027 in Santa Cruz! **New Event: FTO!** This year we have a special addition: **FTO (Face-Turning Octahedron)**, an event that expands the competition possibilities and gives participants the opportunity to experience a new challenge in the world of speedcubing. Whether you're a seasoned competitor or participating for the first time, this is a chance to enjoy, compete, and share our passion for cubes!
